prompt:
Relic icon for the roguelike card game Slay the Spire. Hand-painted game icon: a thick, bold, dark navy outline around the whole silhouette, cel shading with two or three tones, a few crisp highlights, light from the upper left. Chunky, compact proportions so the object stays readable when shrunk to 64 pixels: no thin spindly parts and no tiny details. Palette: deep blues and cyans with small gold, silver or warm wood accents. Match the finish and palette of the reference relic (a blue crystal in a silver frame); ignore the reference's flat green background.

Composition: a single object, centred, filling about 75% of the canvas, fully visible. Transparent background. No cast shadow, no text or letters, no frame or border, no scenery.

Subject: a sturdy traveller's potion flask with a rounded glass body, a cork stopper, a short leather strap and a brass collar, half filled with glowing blue liquid.
